risk.detail: Current commit and external orchestration decisions are intentionally local/unknown; status never infers them.

observedIssues.detail: Batch-1 parallel execution exposed local CPU contention: three strict full-quality finishes ran concurrently and took about 11 minutes each versus about 10 minutes for the comparable serial WI-03 run. Implementation work remained independent, but full-suite verification was resource-bound; transient generated-report and retry friction also increased rework during the failed quality run.
observedIssues.decision: Keep independent implementation Work Items parallel, but serialize or resource-bound strict full-quality verification slots; defer any shared orchestration policy to WI-14.
observedIssues.resolution: Recorded as a local execution lesson; no cross-Work-Item changes are required in WI-06.

residualRisks.detail: Status freshness is limited to repository-local verification commit bindings and cannot observe external CI or human wait.

reviewReadiness.reason: All required verification passed; residual risk remains documented.
expectedReviewFocus: Cross-Work-Item and stale-evidence diagnostics must never produce green status.
